Primary evidence supports an integrin/PMP22 complex and effects of PMP22 deficiency; it does not establish directional integrin activation of PMP22 expression.
Binding/complex and PMP22-knockout phenotypes cannot certify the returned directional activation edge as a transcriptional regulator.

DNA damage-linked YAP1 phosphorylation favors p73 proapoptotic targets; this materially challenges a simple YAP equals TEAD growth/myelination hypothesis. Native Schwann evidence is still required.

protocol: exploratory incremental paired search, same active agent and recorded runtime findings followed by local queries

limitations: Not blinded: the active agent has prior v2/specification context, including accession familiarity.
Assisted condition starts from runtime findings; runtime-only discoveries are zero by construction, not proof of independent-arm recall.
Bounded exploratory search, not a preregistered equal-time experiment. No speedup, recall superiority or global uniqueness claim.
Agent/token/USD telemetry and index construction/storage costs are not available; measured times are subtotals.
Literal case-sensitive matches and selected catalog coverage are not biological negatives. Candidate analyses are not completed scientific conclusions.
